about: Documented, unresolved listening concerns from earlier phases, attached to the matching dashboard recording (reciterId + surah + provider). Each entry cites the report that established it. Nothing here approves or blocks timing by itself: concerns are shown to the reviewer; notReviewable lists recordings that have no review package and why. Edit only with a source.
